precision: existing frozen bfloat16 ASR and unchanged PLL dtype
batch: one recording; PLL32 masked token batch
pair_order: first32bit SHA256(V156_ORDER|session|anonid) mod2; both paths reset fixed V114 inference random stream
sharing: Own encoder states and own firstbeam search; no crosspath neural reuse
sample_design: Census outer-trigger or normalized-native-output-change union, random10 per language/duration-quintile ordinary stratum, without replacement
internal_events: Log actual fallback/noSpeech events during sampled execution. Output-change census is NOT a census of all internal recovery events.
estimate: Per session corpus mean=sum_h population_h/sample_h*sum sampled t / corpus_N. Average3session means; records weighted by population, not equal languages.
uncertainty: Paired stratified record-bootstrap conditional on3observed sessions, census strata fixed, ordinary FPC; also report3session estimates/range separately. Do not treat repeated rows as independent records.
sample_or_session_expansion: None beyond frozen3sessions and fixed samples; no stopping at significance
interference: NVML100ms physical-GPU observer; discard entire affected pair, do not stop unrelated jobs; finite12h wall-clock ceiling
formal_parity: Every final recording hash must equal immutable old NplusR/SplusR before accepted as cost evidence
claims: One checkpoint/device/software profile; no blind/general efficiency guarantee
